mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill (tenant_id, type, name, install_spec, description, source_type, package_oss_ref, package_file_name, package_size, package_md5, creator_id, is_deleted, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{type}, #{name}, #{installSpec}, #{description}, #{sourceType}, #{packageOssRef}, #{packageFileName}, #{packageSize}, #{packageMd5}, #{creatorId}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM skill WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE skill SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, description = #{description}, source_type = #{sourceType}, package_oss_ref = #{packageOssRef}, package_file_name = #{packageFileName}, package_size = #{packageSize}, package_md5 = #{packageMd5}, install_spec = #{installSpec}, version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE skill SET is_deleted = 1, name = CONCAT('#deleted-', id), version = version + 1, modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM skill WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND type = #{type} AND name = #{name} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
